core_obligations: Localise at a point: choose an affine scheme mapping smoothly to the target through the given point (proof lines 8994-8998)

Base change: the fibre product of the source with that scheme is quasi-compact, so it admits a smooth cover by an affine scheme, and the scheme theoretic image of the base-changed morphism is the base change of the scheme theoretic image (proof lines 8999-9006)
Density: the image of the presenting affine scheme in that image is dense by the corresponding statement for schemes, so the image of the base-changed source is dense as well (proof lines 9007-9013)

Conclusion: the chosen point of the target lies in the image of the presenting scheme, and the openness of the map on spaces makes the image of the base-changed source open around it, so the point is in the closure of the image of the original morphism (proof lines 9014-9015)
proof_roadmap: 取点 z ∈ |Z|，取仿射 V 满光滑映到 Y 且 v ↦ z。
X ×_Y V 准紧 ⇒ 有仿射 W 满光滑映到它；由平坦基变换的 scheme theoretic image 公式，Z ×_Y V 就是 X ×_Y V → V 的像。
W → V 的像稠密（概型情形）；又 v ∈ Z，|V| → |Y| 开 ⇒ z 在 |f| 的像的闭包中。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a morphism of algebraic stacks a point lying in the closure of the image of the morphism is a point of the space of its scheme theoretic image (author lemma at source lines 8986-8992, label lemma-topology-scheme-theoretic-image). The proof (source lines 8994-9016) localises at the point, base changes along a smooth cover of the target by an affine scheme, replaces the base-changed source by an affine scheme covering it, uses density of the image in the scheme case, and concludes with openness of the map on spaces (proof lines 8994-9015). The base change step and the final topology argument are the content. H3.
